name: AI Assistant
tagline: Ask your business anything, in plain English.
description: A chat built into your apps that knows your customers, deals, bookings and invoices, so you can get answers, drafts and summaries without digging through screens.
problem: The answers are in your apps, but finding them means clicking through five screens and building reports by hand.
audience: Anyone who would rather ask than search
benefits: Get answers from all your apps in one chat
Draft reminders and replies in seconds
Gets more useful with every app you add
demoFeatures: Ask about quotes, bookings and invoices
Draft a payment reminder or follow-up
Links straight to the record it talks about
productionOptions: Connected to the AI provider of your choice
Works across every app you have installed
Asks before it sends or changes anything
